Independent criterion-to-requirement review found no concrete instance of a graded product demand absent from the brief/rules or professional presentation defaults. Path shorthand below is relative to the frozen task, except explicitly named raw artifacts. All 157 criteria and their injected prompts were read, not just a generated checklist.

Requirement map: gates/render/judge.toml:23 and gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-26 establish real sign-in/intake/shared reads requested by instruction.md:5,9,11,13 and hireops_rules.md:11-17,25-45,199-213,357-387; no imported operational roster, particular descriptive fields, SQLite browser inference, ID prefix or API schema is demanded. Functional numeric/date rows (judge.toml:29-92) map to rules:71-87,203-213,292-305; the extreme exact-money values in :65 are within the explicitly promised exact safe-integer-cent domain, not an invented precision rule. Composition/band rows (:101-137), all role/tier/dual-control rows (:146-452), budget/settlement/lineage/vesting/referral/history rows (:461-722 and :839-929) map to rules sections 1-9: intrinsic and separate annual/run-rate/basis formulas, seeded authority matrix, inclusive budget equality, append-only movements/payments, revision grants and original anchors, separate calendar schedules, referral fixed clock, valid session access, immutable readable history and restart storage are each public. Exact 401/403 expectations (:731-830) are expressly in rules:370-387; they are not inferred from the golden. The conditional DRAFT row :677 expressly accepts omitted optional operational history, matching instruction.md:11 and rules:91-95.

All coordinated rows (:938-1325) map to rules:424-481. Two-through-four members, six terms, nonblank actor operation key, reorder-invariant intent, 409 intent/freshness conflicts, net final budgets, no reservation during preview, durable original previews/receipts, source/destination preservation, one atomic batch, same-operation concurrent success, different overlapping operation conflict, disjoint success and original-result retries after later writes/restart are explicit. Replaying computed claims is conditional on actual UI-observed claim fields (functional/prompt.md:39-41,63); shapes with no claims, ignored/rejected unsupported fields and arbitrary route layouts remain accepted under rules:53-55,363-368,431-436,459-460. No private route or invented required API key is used as a scoring bar.

Polish rows (:23,32,41,50,59) map to instruction.md:3,7: revision/change-set inputs must remain available after refusal, failed rescission keeps the effective date, failures are explained, and a lost commit response must support the same operation. Ordinary native numeric/date validation, equivalent wording, and a read-only retained-date confirmation plus Retry are explicitly accepted; the test does not demand extra fields, free-text dates or fabricated HTTP errors. Visual rows (:24-89) apply professional readability/consistency to the requested clear desktop workspace. visual/prompt.md:10 explicitly allows alternate layouts/labels/styles/routes and forbids screenshot, framework, mobile-layout or theme-switch requirements, consistent with instruction.md:5.

Conforming alternatives considered: an initially empty operational desk, generated UUIDs, different routes/labels, expandable financial details, no computed claims in writes, native date inputs, over-budget refusal deferred until commit, and a retained-date read-only Retry surface. Each is preserved by the relevant language (functional/prompt.md:13,23,27,39,49,57; functional/judge.toml:677,947; polish/judge.toml:32,41). The local empty_operational_seed witness removes all optional operational arrays (local/batch-witnesses.cjs:13-16) and its results report all 15 finite HTTP groups succeeded. Its four recorded source hashes match the frozen modules. This is bounded corroboration for the optional-roster alternative, not proof of full UI judgment.
